reasoning: The icon is the IEC technical symbol for direct current (DC) or a UI stroke/border style toggle (solid over dashed line). To most users it looks like abstract interface chrome or an equals sign rather than a concrete subject, and tasks about power or electronics are much better served by a plug, battery, or lightning bolt icon.
